highlights: Tracks release activity across multiple repos
Summarizes release notes in one digest
Supports authenticated or anonymous GitHub API access
name: GitHub Release Radar
description: Watch a list of repositories for new GitHub releases and post a release digest to WEBHOOK_URL.

files.content:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
python -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check --quiet -r requirements.txt
python main.py
